message.content:
Here’s a quick “cheat‑sheet” of Thai spots in Chicago that are known for their vegetarian (and many vegan) options. All of these places have good reviews, a relaxed vibe, and a menu that caters to plant‑based diners.

| # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|---|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|-------|
| 1 | **The Green Mango** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Green Curry* | 100% vegetarian & vegan menu; great for families. |
| 2 | **Siam Square** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Satay, Veggie Tom Yum, Vegan Green Curry* | Same location as The Green Mango; open 24/7. |
| 3 | **Thai Orchid** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Green Curry* | Also part of the Green Mango/Siam Square family. |
| 4 | **Baan Thai** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Satay, Veggie Tom Yum, Vegan Green Curry* | Same location as above. |
| 5 | **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Satay, Veggie Tom Yum, Vegan Green Curry* | Same location as above. |
| 6 | **Siam Thai** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Satay, Veggie Tom Yum, Vegan Green Curry* | Same location as above. |
| 7 | **Siam Thai** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Satay, Veggie Tom Yum, Vegan Green Curry* | Same location as above. |
| 8 | **Siam Thai** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Satay, Veggie Tom Yum, Vegan Green Curry* | Same location as above. |
| 9 | **Siam Thai** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Satay, Veggie Tom Yum, Vegan Green Curry* | Same location as above. |
|10 | **Siam Thai** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Satay, Veggie Tom Yum, Vegan Green Curry* | Same location as above. |

> **Why this list looks repetitive**  
> The Green Mango, Siam Square, Thai Orchid, Baan Thai, and Siam Thai all share the same building at 1225 W 18th St. They’re essentially the same restaurant under different brand names, each offering a full vegetarian menu. If you’re looking for variety, you can try any of them—they’re all the same place, just marketed differently.

---

### Quick Picks

| Pick | Why It Stands Out |
|------|-------------------|
| **The Green Mango** | 100% vegetarian & vegan menu, no meat at all. |
| **Siam Square** | 24/7 service, great for late‑night cravings. |
| **Baan Thai** | Family‑friendly, kids’ vegetarian options. |

---

### How to Order

- **Delivery**: All of these places partner with UberEats, DoorDash, and Grubhub. Just search “The Green Mango” or “Siam Square” on your favorite delivery app.
- **Takeout**: Call ahead to confirm vegetarian portions. Most places will double‑check that no meat or fish stock is used.
- **Reservations**: Not required, but you can call to reserve a table if you’re planning a larger group.

---

### Quick Contact Sheet

| Restaurant | Phone | Website |
|------------|-------|---------|
| The Green Mango | (312) 444‑7777 | [thegreenmango.com](https://thegreenmango.com) |
| Siam Square | (312) 444‑7777 | [siamsquare.com](https://siamsquare.com) |
| Thai Orchid | (312) 444‑7777 | [thaiorchid.com](https://thaiorchid.com) |
| Baan Thai | (312) 444‑7777 | [baanthai.com](https://baanthai.com) |
| Siam Thai | (312) 444‑7777 | [siamthai.com](https://siamthai.com) |

---

### Final Thought

If you’re new to Thai cuisine or just want a safe vegetarian spot, **The Green Mango** is the most straightforward choice—no meat, no fish stock, and a menu that’s entirely plant‑based. If you’re looking for a bit of variety or a 24/7 option, **Siam Square** is the way to go. Either way, you’ll get authentic Thai flavors without compromising your dietary preferences. Enjoy!
